_note: Name-facts for Morocco (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: From ribat, a fortified monastery that stood here in the 12th century.
The Hassan Tower, the minaret of a mosque begun in 1195, was never finished.
It has been the capital only since 1912.
it: Da ribat, un monastero fortificato che sorgeva qui nel XII secolo.
La torre Hassan, il minareto di una moschea iniziata nel 1195, non fu mai finita.
